description: A short, thick-forearmed woman with a burn scar that climbs out of her collar and stops just under her jaw, and the permanent squint of somebody who has looked into a forge for a living. She talks to you while working and does not stop working.

root.text: "Mind the floor, it's all grit." She sets something glowing back into the coals. "You after an edge, or just warm?"

options.text: Let me see what you have.
I don't know one end from the other.

shop.text: She wipes her hands and lifts the counter flap.

green.text: "Then take the leaf-spring off the rack by the door. It's free, it's rubbish, and it'll teach you more in a month than that" — she nods at the glass case — "will teach you in a year. Come back when you've stopped cutting yourself."

marques.text: "House work is mine — the Trueline. Circle mark on every one, signature on the ones that earned it. Redlaw is transit-warden surplus, good steel, boring. Blackvane is behind the glass and you can look at it." She pauses. "And if somebody in the Reach offers you a Blackvane with a motor on it, that is a decal and a chainsaw and your own business."

bye.text: She is already back at the wheel.

clothing_layers: a scorched leather forge apron, scarred white where sparks have landed
a sleeveless work shirt gone grey at the seams
a plain sports bra and cotton shorts

name: Vessa Orme
